name: Ridgeline 2P Ultralight Tent
description: Two-person, three-season freestanding tent at 1.1 kg packed. Silnylon fly with 1500 mm hydrostatic head, two doors and two vestibules, DAC aluminium poles. Pitches fly-first in the rain.

name: Basecamp 4 Family Tent
description: Four-person cabin tent with near-vertical walls, 2.0 m peak height, and a gear loft. Polyester fly rated 3000 mm. Best for car camping; 7.4 kg packed.

name: Summit Bivy Shelter
description: Single-wall bivy with a waterproof-breathable eVent top and a bathtub floor. 620 g. Built for alpine starts and fast-and-light ridge traverses.

name: Aster 15°F Down Sleeping Bag
description: 800-fill hydrophobic goose down, EN comfort rating -4 °C, lower limit -9 °C. Draft collar, full-length two-way zip, 980 g. Includes a cotton storage sack.

name: Trailhead 30°F Synthetic Bag
description: Synthetic fill that keeps insulating when wet. Comfort rating 4 °C. Machine washable. Rectangular cut that unzips into a quilt for warm nights.

name: Loft R5 Insulated Sleeping Pad
description: Air pad with an R-value of 5.4 for four-season use. 7.6 cm thick, 510 g, inflates in about 12 breaths with the included pump sack.

name: Cellular Foam Pad
description: Closed-cell foam pad, R-value 2.0, that cannot puncture. Folds accordion-style and doubles as a sit pad at camp.

name: Traverse 55L Trekking Pack
description: 55-litre pack with an adjustable torso length (40-52 cm), aluminium stay frame and a ventilated mesh back panel. Carries up to 18 kg comfortably. Rain cover included.

name: Cirque 30L Daypack
description: 30-litre daypack with a hydration sleeve, ice-axe loop, and a removable hip belt. Weighs 820 g. Fits carry-on limits.

name: Expedition 70L Pack
description: 70-litre load hauler with a carbon frame sheet and a pivoting hip belt for loads over 25 kg. Top lid converts to a summit bag.

name: Storm Shell 3L Rain Jacket
description: Three-layer waterproof-breathable membrane rated 28,000 mm and 25,000 g/m²/24h. Helmet-compatible hood, pit zips, and fully taped seams.

name: Featherline 800 Down Jacket
description: Hooded puffy with 800-fill down and a ripstop nylon shell. Packs into its own chest pocket. Not waterproof: wear under a shell in rain.

name: Grid Fleece Midlayer
description: Grid fleece that breathes during climbs and dries fast. Thumb loops and a half zip. Pairs with the Storm Shell as a mid layer.

name: Approach Softshell Pants
description: Stretch softshell pants with a DWR finish, articulated knees, and ankle zips for boots. Wind resistant but not waterproof.

name: Merino 150 Base Layer Top
description: 150 g/m² merino wool base layer that resists odour on multi-day trips. Flatlock seams. Hand wash cold.

name: Talus Mid GTX Hiking Boot
description: Mid-height boot with a waterproof membrane and a Vibram outsole. Medium-volume last; size half up for thick socks. Break-in about 20 km.

name: Skyline Trail Runner
description: Trail running shoe with a 4 mm drop, 5 mm lugs, and a rock plate. Drains fast after stream crossings. Not waterproof.

name: Camp Sandal
description: Lightweight sandal for camp and river crossings, 190 g per pair.

name: Jetline Canister Stove
description: Canister stove that boils 1 litre in 3 minutes 10 seconds. Piezo igniter, pot supports for pans up to 20 cm. Uses isobutane-propane canisters.

name: Polar Multi-Fuel Stove
description: Liquid fuel stove that burns white gas, kerosene or diesel. Works below -20 °C where canisters lose pressure. Field maintainable.

name: Titanium 900 ml Pot
description: 900 ml titanium pot with a folding handle and a lid that doubles as a strainer. Fits a 230 g canister and a small stove inside.

name: Squeeze Water Filter
description: Hollow-fibre filter that removes 99.99999% of bacteria and protozoa. Threads onto standard bottles. Backflush to restore flow. Does not remove viruses.

name: UV Water Purifier Pen
description: UV-C purifier that treats 1 litre in 90 seconds and kills viruses, bacteria and protozoa. USB-C rechargeable, about 50 litres per charge. Water must be clear.

name: Ranger Handheld GPS
description: GPS and GLONASS receiver with topo maps, a barometric altimeter, and 16 hours of battery on AA cells. Satellite messaging is not included.

name: Baseplate Compass
description: Liquid-filled baseplate compass with adjustable declination and a sighting mirror. Rulers in 1:25k and 1:50k scales.

name: Personal Locator Beacon
description: 406 MHz PLB that alerts search and rescue anywhere with sky view. No subscription. 24-hour transmit time; register it with your national authority.

name: Trail First Aid Kit
description: First aid kit for 1-4 people on trips up to 4 days: blister care, wound closure strips, SAM splint, and a printed field guide.

name: Beam 400 Headlamp
description: 400-lumen headlamp with red night mode and a lock-out switch. USB-C rechargeable; 40 hours on low. IPX7 waterproof.

name: Carbon Trekking Poles
description: Three-section carbon poles with flick locks, 105-135 cm, 420 g per pair. Cork grips. Includes snow and mud baskets.

name: Bear-Resistant Food Canister
description: Polycarbonate canister approved for use in parks that require bear-proof storage. 11.5 litres, about 5 days of food for one person.

name: Returns and exchanges
description: Unused gear can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. Used gear can be exchanged within 1 year if it fails under normal use. Sleeping bags and pads must be clean and dry.

name: Shipping
description: Orders over 75 ship free within 3-5 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1-2 business days. Fuel canisters ship ground only.

name: Lifetime warranty
description: Tents, packs and sleeping bags carry a lifetime warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. Damage from accidents, wear, or animals is repaired at cost.
